card.name: Commas after sodium chloride in IV fluids
card.fires_on: Mostly the comma right after 'Sodium Chloride' (or 'Injection') in lists of IV fluid ingredients and compatibility statements. Also fires on 'Multiple' in 'Multiple Electrolytes' fluid names.

modes.label: Comma after Sodium Chloride
modes.description: A comma that follows Sodium Chloride or Sodium Chloride Injection in a fluid composition list.
modes.example: a solution containing Sodium Chloride<<,>> Sodium Lactate, Potassium Chlor

modes.label: Multiple in fluid names
modes.description: The word 'Multiple' opening 'Multiple Electrolytes' in an IV fluid product name.
